# Biscuit Follows His Nose

*Biscuit has caught a smell and wants you to come with him: out to the wayside well on the Hedge Lanes, where the slimes have been at somebody's dropped lunch. Clear 20 slimes so he can investigate.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Biscuit](../npcs/biscuit.md) |
| Level | 6 |

## Objectives

- Reach the wayside well in [The Hedge Lanes](../maps/hedge_lanes.md)
- Defeat 20 [Slime](../monsters/slime.md) in [The Hedge Lanes](../maps/hedge_lanes.md)

## Rewards

- 100 EXP
- 60 mesos
- [Red Potion](../items/red_potion.md) x3
- +10 standing with Selsior
- +100 standing with [Biscuit](../npcs/biscuit.md)
